youtube.description:
Kiro not following your steering file? 5 things to check

Kiro ignoring your steering? Run these five checks.

1. Right folder - Workspace rules live in .kiro/steering.
2. Check the mode - Is it always, file match, manual or auto?
3. File match pattern - It loads only when matching files are in play.
4. Manual means manual - Manual rules load only when you call them.
5. Keep rules short - Short, specific rules are easier to follow.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/steering/
